# UI Architecture Requirements Checklist: UI Stack Redesign

**Purpose**: Validate whether the UI replacement and sidecar architecture requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and acceptance-ready.
**Created**: 2026-05-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the five primary product areas fully enumerated as one required release scope, including their user-facing purpose and completion boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §CC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the binding design baseline artifacts identified with enough specificity for reviewers to determine which visual and interaction requirements apply? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for replacing prototype sample data, fake counts, placeholder controls, and unavailable design actions across all five screens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK004 Are backend readiness states documented as user-visible requirements for startup, ready, degraded, failed, and shutdown conditions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Backend Connection State]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements specified for removing legacy PyQt entry points and primary UI code after redesign acceptance, including the absence of a maintained fallback? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, Spec §CC-010]
- [x] CHK006 Are regression coverage requirements documented for each migrated screen and for the redesigned UI to backend bridge? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, Spec §SC-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "visual and interaction baseline" clarified with specific review dimensions such as layout, navigation, density, component hierarchy, and page flow? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK008 Is "real product data" defined clearly enough to distinguish supported empty, loading, error, and business-action states from design-only placeholders? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §CC-009]
- [x] CHK009 Is the expected persistence of same-window screen state described with objective boundaries rather than relying on "reasonably expect" alone? [Ambiguity, Spec §User Story 1 Acceptance Scenario 3]
- [x] CHK010 Is "compact execution summary" defined with sufficient information-density and disclosure criteria for the assistant workflow? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK011 Are the branded red/yellow/green custom window controls mapped unambiguously to close, minimize, and maximize/restore semantics on Windows? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Spec §CC-011]
- [x] CHK012 Is "real supported capability" clarified for design-visible settings, commands, and actions that did not exist in the legacy UI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, Spec §CC-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are the five P1 user stories consistent with the all-screens-in-one-accepted-release constraint? [Consistency, Spec §User Stories, Spec §CC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Are fresh-install acceptance assumptions consistent with the requirement to avoid corrupting, deleting, or mutating legacy local data? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, Spec §CC-013, Spec §SC-012]
- [x] CHK015 Are Settings requirements consistent with the unified configuration and secret-storage constraints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Spec §CC-004]
- [x] CHK016 Are assistant confirmation requirements consistent with existing non-modal confirmation semantics, queued confirmations, and new-conversation cleanup behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §CC-006]
- [x] CHK017 Are recording UI requirements consistent with browser, extension, and desktop mode contracts, including desktop health review and monitor/DPI behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-011, Spec §CC-007]
- [x] CHK018 Are plan-level Tauri/React/FastAPI sidecar decisions consistent with the spec-level requirement that UI calls business services or bridges only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Summary, Plan §Structure Decision]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Can the "no blocker or major visual-flow deviations" outcome be objectively assessed against the approved design baseline? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK020 Are time-based outcomes for assistant, teaching, and startup flows tied to measurable start and end points? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK021 Is the "zero visible sample records, fake counts, or pretend actions" outcome measurable across normal, empty, and degraded states? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK022 Can the "100% of settings, commands, and actions" requirement be traced to an inventory of visible design controls? [Traceability, Spec §SC-011, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK023 Are bridge failure acceptance criteria specific enough to distinguish backend unavailable, degraded, failed health check, and shutdown paths? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-019, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are primary happy-path requirements complete for app shell, assistant, teaching, skills/compositions, and settings? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories]
- [x] CHK025 Are alternate flow requirements defined for conversation search, rename, delete, teaching mode selection, failure retry/ignore, and composition mode selection? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK026 Are exception flow requirements documented for missing recording prerequisites, invalid settings, unavailable providers, and backend startup failure? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK027 Are recovery requirements defined for desktop recording sanity failure choices, high-risk confirmation cleanup, stale composition review, and sidecar shutdown? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK028 Are non-functional scenario requirements documented for launch readiness, responsive navigation and typing, packaging, sidecar auth, and secret masking? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Performance Goals, Plan §Constraints]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Are zero-state requirements specified for no conversations, no learned skills, no pending skills, no failed teaching records, and no published skills for composition? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Are long-history and markdown assistant output requirements defined without exposing archive/compression terminology to users? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, Spec §CC-006, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for high-risk assistant actions queued while the user starts a new conversation or switches screens? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]

- [x] CHK033 Are requirements documented for legacy local data presence under a fresh-install acceptance model? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-027, Spec §SC-012]
